name: After § 64
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: A. whereas since its adoption, the EU Youth Strategy (EUYS) has had to adapt to major crises, including the COVID-19 pandemic, economic instability and geopolitical tensions, which, combined with pre-existing challenges such as youth unemployment, housing affordability, mental health concerns, environmental sustainability, the use of AI tools reshaping education, work and social interactions among young people, rural-urban disparities, and uneven access to quality education and training, have shaped the opportunities and constraints faced by the 73 million young EU citizens;
